name: Pixel 10 Pro Fold
updatePolicy: 7 years of OS and security updates from US Google Store availability
notes: ro.product.model is the marketing name ("Pixel 10 Pro Fold"); the G-prefixed codes are the regulatory/hardware model numbers printed on the box and in Settings > About phone > Regulatory labels. ro.product.device is the codename. maxAndroid is projected: support runs until about October 2032 and assumes Android major releases continue each June. Tensor G5 SoC codename is "laguna"; ro.board.platform not verified on a device, so boardPlatforms is left empty. Cover-screen camera: 10MP wide. display = main (inner) foldable panel; cover display: OLED, 120Hz, HDR, Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2, 6.4 inches, 1080 x 2364 pixels, 2000 nits (HBM), 3000 nits (peak).
